meaning: very clumsy when using your hands to do something
literal_translation: ser muito desajeitado com as mãos
example: I am all thumbs when I try to fix things.
origin: Refers to the idea that thumbs get in the way when a person tries to do a fine task with the hands.

wrong_meanings.why_wrong: This describes a physical pain, not a lack of skill with the hands.

wrong_meanings.meaning: to be very good with your hands
wrong_meanings.why_wrong: This is the opposite of the idiom, which describes being clumsy.
The idiom has nothing to do with happiness or emotions.

explanation: 'All thumbs' describes a person who is clumsy and does not do tasks with the hands well. It is often used in a friendly, joking way.
